summary: Zhu Tianpeng smashes the puppet with his rake, and A Li finishes it with fox fire; the creature dissolves into mist.

retention_analysis: Puppet defeated, purple mist dispersing. Zhu Tianpeng breathing hard, A Li smiling. The path ahead clearer. Carries into act 23.

detailed_description:
[Frame continuity] Opens on the last frame of act 21: <Subject 7> (tail-frame image from <Picture 8> to be supplied after act 21 renders) — [Shot 2] medium shot, the character center raises her vine staff <Picture 9>, a green energy shield blooming in front of the group. the character right launches his flying sword <Picture 8> at the pup. Cross-act state: character injuries, costume damage, weapon states, and scene changes from act 21 must carry over; no state may revert. This shot continues seamlessly from that frame.

[Shot 1] medium shot, the puppet breaks through the green shield fragments in center, swiping a twisted arm. <Subject 2> charges from left of frame, nine-tooth rake <Picture 3> raised over his shoulder, golden eyes fierce, robe flaring.
[Shot 2] At 00:01.500, <Subject 2> slams the rake down onto the puppet's head in center frame — the nine curved teeth bite in, the puppet's body cracking with dark energy, driven into the mossy ground with a thunderous impact.
[Shot 3] At 00:03.500, <Subject 3> from right of frame launches a ball of white fox fire (no reference image, described in text) at the downed puppet. The fire engulfs it, and the puppet dissolves into purple mist that scatters in the wind.
